children: Shares of Sono Group were trading higher in the day's after-hour session, following news the company had signed a nonbinding letter of intent to merge with Sports One.
After the bell, Sono Group shares were trading 89% higher, at $5.09. Volume after hours topped 2.2 million shares. The stock ended the days regular session at $2.68, basically flat on the day.

Sono Group said the combined company would acquire and hold minority interests in sports franchises, including teams in the NFL, NBA, MLB and NHL, and combine that with an operating sports intelligence business. The combined company is expected to be renamed Sports One.
Sports One equity holders would own a super majority of the combined public company.

Concurrent with the signing of the letter of intent, an investor group purchased 19.9% of Sono's outstanding ordinary shares at market price, with no discount, no warrant coverage and subject to a 180-day investor lock-up, the company added. Proceeds from the sale will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes.
